title: SDK & API compatibility matrix and coordinated release notes for function-calling, structured output, and streaming samples
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a coordinated launch plan that produces: a language-agnostic compatibility matrix for the SDKs and REST API, canonical release notes and a templated changelog for function-calling, structured output, and streaming; synchronized sample snippets across SDKs; and a cross-team checklist for doc freeze, bug bash, and staged rollouts.
scope: Produce a compatibility matrix that documents feature parity and known divergences between JS, Python, Go SDKs and the REST API
Ship canonical release notes and a release-note template for PM/PR writers
Create/update sample snippets for function-calling, structured output validation, and streaming in all SDKs and docs
Coordinate cross-team bug-bash and doc freeze calendar
Out of scope: full SDK implementation work (owned by ENG tickets) and performance benchmarking (separate ENG initiative)
tasks: Draft compatibility matrix spreadsheet (columns: feature, SDK-Python, SDK-JS, SDK-Go, REST, notes)
Collect engineering notes on edge behaviors (stream chunk ordering, function-calling error semantics, structured-output validation failures)
Author release notes template and example release note for sdk-2026.03
Canonicalize sample snippets (live-tested) and add to docs repo and SDK sample folder
Schedule cross-functional bug bash and run checklist
Coordinate doc freeze date and staging deploy for docs and sample pages
Publish coordinated changelog entry and blog draft; hand off to comms
timeline: 2026-03-08: Sample snippets implemented in CI and smoke-tested
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility matrix published in Confluence and referenced in SDK README(s)
Release notes template merged and an example release note for the current release exists
All sample snippets run in CI (smoke tests) and are included in the docs landing pages
Cross-team bug bash issues triaged and critical fixes scheduled before doc freeze
Docs and SDK samples staged and validated with QA and one external partner integration test
risks_mitigation: Risk: Snippet drift between SDKs — Mitigation: enforce sample canonicalization step and CI smoke test
Risk: Last-minute API behavior change — Mitigation: require API change sign-off and freeze window; fallback messaging in release notes
Risk: Missing edge-case semantics for function-calling — Mitigation: collect engineering known-issues and include in release notes compatibility table
Risk: Streaming semantics differ across SDKs (chunk framing) — Mitigation: add explicit example and small test harness to repo
